commands.command: targeted OIDC config, store and PKCE flow with -race

verifiedBehavior: OIDC configuration is disabled unless issuer, client ID and client secret are complete.
Discovery, S256 PKCE, state, nonce and signed ID token verification pass against a local provider.
A verified email links an existing account and repeat login returns the same user.
Auto-create is opt-in and creates an OIDC-only account.
A second provider subject for the same user is rejected.
Tampered callbacks redirect with a generic error and never establish a session.
The public auth configuration exposes only enabled state and display name.
